record: AUTHORITATIVE -- supersedes results/gate_status_sba_arm.json, which records the SBA arm alone
rule: Section 5.2: the gate passes only if Kendall tau between the simulator's ranking of the learner configurations and EACH real-data ranking is at least 0.6 and no pairwise sign among the top three configurations disagrees on either real dataset.
configurations_note: the same six on both arms, as fixed in 10_gate_kendall.py
reasons: tau = -0.60 on SBA is below the 0.6 threshold
1 of 3 pairwise signs among the top three disagree on SBA
tau = -0.20 on HomeCredit is below the 0.6 threshold
1 of 3 pairwise signs among the top three disagree on HomeCredit
consequence: no simulator-based ranking is reported and the source-level analysis is confined to the real datasets (SBA's three sources and Home Credit's four); the simulator's seven-source Saudi attribution is WITHHELD
note: The gate failing is the pre-specified conservative rule working as designed, not a failure of the run. Both real arms were computed on the same six configurations against the same simulator ranking.
